title: Acceptance and benefits of artificial intelligence in the preoperative evaluation of patients in anaesthesiology - interviews and questionnaires with patients and doctors in anaesthesiology and process analysis of a preoperative evaluation
summary: In this study, we are investigating how patients aged 60 and over and anaesthetists experience the use of artificial intelligence (AI) in preparation for operations. To this end, we are conducting interviews, handing out questionnaires and anonymously observing processes in the anaesthesia outpatient department. The aim is to find out how AI can be used sensibly and safely in this area in the future.
conditions: It is not a specific disease.

interventions.name: Survey of the attitudes, experiences and concerns of patients aged 60 and over regarding the use of artificial intelligence (AI) in preoperative evaluation using interviews and questionnaires.

Survey of the attitudes, experiences and assessments of anaesthetists on the possibilities and challenges of using artificial intelligence (AI) in preoperative evaluation by means of interviews and questionnaires.

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
Participants: Patients aged >60 years and doctors at the clinic.                                                                                               - Location: Anaesthesia outpatient clinic.                                                                                                                                    - Type of interviews: Face-to-face interviews.                                                                                                         - Questionnaires: Structured questionnaires are used
Exclusion criteria:
Refusal by patients/doctors
